verdict.rationale: Better Stack documents a global API token described as valid for "managing anything within Better Stack" and provides Uptime-specific API docs with bearer-token auth, suggesting broad API coverage, but there is no explicit claim or evidence of full UI/API parity, and probes show no discoverable OpenAPI spec (404s on all candidate paths), making it hard to verify completeness. Missing for 10: an explicit API-vs-UI parity statement, a full OpenAPI/API reference covering all UI features (incidents, status pages, on-call, AI SRE), and independent confirmation that all UI actions are API-accessible.
